entries.source: জাপানি ইয়েন ও বাংলাদেশি টাকার reference rate দেখুন এবং কোন ধরনের transfer channel আপনার পরিস্থিতিতে ভালো হতে পারে তা তুলনা করুন।
entries.target: See the reference rate for Japanese yen and Bangladeshi taka, and compare which type of transfer channel may suit your situation.
Once the rate loads, the calculation will be shown.

entries.source: . Provider-এর actual send/receive rate ও fee আলাদা হতে পারে।
entries.target: . The provider's actual send/receive rate and fee may differ.

entries.source: Japan থেকে JPY দিয়ে Bangladesh-এ BDT পাঠানো যায়; recipient bank account, bKash বা Nagad support থাকতে পারে। Fee ও delivery estimate transfer setup-এর সময় live দেখুন।
entries.target: You can send BDT to Bangladesh from Japan in JPY; the recipient's bank account, bKash or Nagad may be supported. See the fee and delivery estimate live during the transfer setup.

entries.source: বড় amount, formal bank trail বা specific beneficiary bank requirement থাকলে useful হতে পারে। Sending bank + intermediary + receiving bank fee আলাদা হতে পারে।
entries.target: It may be useful for large amounts, a formal bank trail, or a specific beneficiary bank requirement. Sending bank + intermediary + receiving bank fees may apply separately.

entries.source: Recipient-এর bank account না থাকলে cash pickup service useful হতে পারে। Availability, ID requirement, fee এবং exchange rate provider অনুযায়ী check করুন।
entries.target: If the recipient has no bank account, a cash pickup service may be useful. Check availability, ID requirements, fees and the exchange rate with the provider.

entries.source: একটা provider সব সময় সবার জন্য best নয়
entries.target: One provider is not always the best for everyone

entries.source: Live quote-এ recipient কত BDT পাবে সেটা তুলনা করুন। Wise-এর মতো online service সাধারণত সহজ comparison দেয়।
entries.target: Compare how much BDT the recipient will get in the live quote. Online services like Wise usually make comparison easy.

entries.source: Transfer limit, source-of-funds document, bank compliance এবং total fee আগে দেখুন। শুধু headline FX rate দেখে সিদ্ধান্ত নেবেন না।
entries.target: Check the transfer limit, source-of-funds documents, bank compliance and total fee first. Do not decide based only on the headline FX rate.

entries.source: Delivery ETA + recipient method (bank/bKash/Nagad/cash) priority দিন। Fastest option সবসময় cheapest নাও হতে পারে।
entries.target: Prioritise the delivery ETA + recipient method (bank/bKash/Nagad/cash). The fastest option may not always be the cheapest.

entries.source: এই page financial advice নয় এবং এখানে দেখানো FX rate provider quote নয়। টাকা পাঠানোর আগে provider-এর final fee, exchange rate, transfer limit, eligibility এবং recipient amount যাচাই করুন। Bangladesh-এর remittance incentive থাকলে eligibility/provider support আলাদাভাবে confirm করুন।
entries.target: This page is not financial advice, and the FX rate shown here is not a provider quote. Before sending money, verify the provider's final fee, exchange rate, transfer limit, eligibility and recipient amount. If Bangladesh offers a remittance incentive, confirm eligibility/provider support separately.
